content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D; M.Tech/ M.Sc. in Material Science/Metallurgy and Materials Engg./Polymer Tech. or Engg./Nanosci. & Nanotech./ Mechanical Engg/ Chemical Engg./Chemistry/ Physics/ Applied Physics/ Applied Science/ E&I/ Instrumentation and Control/ Energy Science Other conditions: Candidates must have knowledge of nanocomposite material synthesis and high-temperature materials. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. Desirable: Proficiency in nanomaterial and polymer synthesis, modification, and nanocomposite preparation Experience in material characterization and high-temperature material testing Experience in space-related work Writing skills for technical papers and PPT presentations

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have obtained their Ph.D. degree from IIT Roorkee are not eligible to apply.

content_sections.text: Experimental Studies on composite material synthesis and characterization Aerogel material preparation and sheet fabrication Any other work assigned by the PI from time to time

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Submit application on plain paper with detailed biodata including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Include experience details in research, industrial field and others if any. Attach self-attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Send the application through email to the Principal Investigator. Email it on or before 15 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Applications submitted through any means other than the specified emails will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 15 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 80,000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D and M.Tech/ M.Sc. in relevant engineering or science disciplines.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have knowledge of nanocomposite material synthesis and high-temperature materials. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have obtained their Ph.D. degree from IIT Roorkee are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on qualifications and experience. Interview (online/offline). Online or offline interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration: 2 years (Full-time).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Roorkee.
